text: Kingsmoor FC advances on the left side near the opponent's penalty area, about 7.7 metres from Westport Albion's goal at the far end. After a patient build-up beginning from a free kick deep in their own half, Felix Duarte moves the ball in a series of passes across midfield before delivering a short, precise pass to Viktor Quinlan positioned centrally just outside the penalty box. Quinlan takes a shot with his foot but Westport Albion's defenders block it, denying a clear scoring opportunity. The score remains tied at 2-2.
